newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Terexko buys S.African computer firm.
newsitem.headline: Terexko buys S.African computer firm.

text.p: South Africa's Terexko Ltd said on Friday it had bought a computer servicing business from TCM Computers and TCM Consulting Services for 50.2 million rand.
It said the operations bought were TCM Business Systems, TCM Computers and TCM Consulting Services. The acqusition, however, excluded TCM Small Systems, TCM Software and Services, and TCM Networks.
The buy will be settled through a cash payment of 35.2 million rand and the issue of 5.0 million ordinary shares in Terexko at 300 cents a share.
Terexko said the buys were in line with is aim of providing services in the hospitality sector. TCM has the facilities to operate in the gaming industry which was expected to show strong growth.
TCM had after-tax profit of 8.155 million rand in the year to end-February.
